facts.fact: The World Bank status report says enhancements to the social protection system, including the social registry, are ongoing in preparation for integration with other national systems.
The World Bank report gives 5 social protection programmes (SCT, LIPW, SSB and CLAS) using the Liberia Household Social Registry at 9 June 2025, up from 4 in December 2024, against a target of 6.

note: as_of of the first fact is the report's archive date, the document giving no date for the statement.
